description: List sessions in an Applitools Eyes batch plus batch-wide stats. `filter` narrows to unresolved/unsaved/mismatching sessions; `format` shapes the output (`full` default: stats+session list; `stats`: stats only; `scenarios`: deduplicated, sorted session names only). A low-level primitive: for reviewing or resolving a batch's results, call eyes_review_progress with scope: "batch" instead — it drives the full investigation and calls this internally.

batchUrl.description: Eyes batch URL: https://eyes.applitools.com/app/test-results/{batchId}/?accountId=... (a trailing /{sessionId}[/steps/{N}] is fine too and is ignored — pass a session/step URL here as-is, no need to strip it down)

filter.description: Narrow to sessions matching this state — "mismatching" keeps sessions with at least one step that's non-matching, missing a checkpoint, or new

format.description: Shape of the response; defaults to "full"

workspaceRoot.description: Root directory of the caller's project (optional; used to locate its .env credentials)

name: eyes_inspect_sessions
